description: Threat Assessments on California Rangelands is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by California Landscape Conservation and Adaptation Partnership (CAL CAP); Point Blue Conservation Science. Ranchers, land managers, conservation organizations, planners, and other decision makers can explore six different scenarios to determine how California rangelands and their ecosystem services might be maintained in light of future threats. Coverage: the foothills around California's Central Valley and the southern Inner Coast Range. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
